targets.note: The Automations place on Northwind with New lead follow-up (a Space Automation) and its config pane on Settings: scope with Make a personal copy, owner, access, followers, loops and the access it runs on. The canvas and sidebar are P-L9f_01's.
The Alerts tab: the sentence, who, when, where, and the escalation chain (the prototype has one escalation role; the contract has a chain of steps).
The Runs tab: the latest runs as the shared run row. The prototype side is the same Automation with its Runs shown.
A Personal Automation (My morning briefing): scope with Promote to Space, and the access it runs on.

Promote to Space over a Personal Automation: what it stops using of yours, what it will run on, and the shared API key to choose for the AI step on a subscription sign-in. The prototype opens its sheet only by a click, so its side shows the same Automation's Settings before it.
Client onboarding in the Journey designer: where the records are now, five stages with their tasks (Assigned, Reviewer, Approver, due) and the Automations that run on entering.
The Intake stage selected and its pane: when a record moves on, the time limit, who is told when it runs over, the Automations on it.
A task selected and its pane: Assigned, Reviewer, Approver, the key and backup for the agent, due after entering, required, instructions.

Move in-flight records to the current version: each old stage with its records and where it goes, one without a match to map, nothing moved until the button is pressed. The prototype has no migration sheet (spec 2.12 adds it), so its side is the designer.
The New Journey type sheet. The prototype side is the designer it opens beside.
The same designer over Harbor Studio: one Journey, Client project, four stages. The prototype side is Harbor Studio's Automations place.
